segments.an4.7:1.1: “Cattārome, bhikkhave, viyattā vinītā visāradā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammappaṭipannā saṅghaṃ sobhenti.
segments.an4.7:1.3: Bhikkhu, bhikkhave, viyatto vinīto visārado bahussuto dhammadharo dhammānudhammappaṭipanno saṅghaṃ sobheti.
segments.an4.7:1.4: Bhikkhunī, bhikkhave, viyattā vinītā visāradā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammappaṭipannā saṅghaṃ sobheti.
segments.an4.7:1.5: Upāsako, bhikkhave, viyatto vinīto visārado bahussuto dhammadharo dhammānudhammappaṭipanno saṅghaṃ sobheti.
segments.an4.7:1.6: Upāsikā, bhikkhave, viyattā vinītā visāradā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammappaṭipannā saṅghaṃ sobheti.
segments.an4.7:1.7: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro viyattā vinītā visāradā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammappaṭipannā saṅghaṃ sobhentī”ti.
segments.an4.7:2.1: “Yo hoti viyatto [vyatto (sī. pī.), byatto (syā. kaṃ.)] ca visārado ca,
segments.an4.7:3.3: Upāsako ca yo saddho, yā ca saddhā upāsikā;
segments.an4.7:3.5: Ete kho saṅghaṃ sobhenti, ete hi saṅghasobhanā”ti.

lines: Bhikkhu ca sīlasampannoti gāthāya kiñcāpi ekekasseva ekeko guṇo kathito, sabbesaṃ pana sabbepi vaṭṭantīti.
Vesārajjenāti sārajjakarānaṃ diṭṭhivicikicchādipāpadhammānaṃ vigamanato vesārajjena, sārajjarahitenāti attho.
Tameva pariyattidhammaṃ dhārenti suvaṇṇabhājane pakkhittasīhavasaṃ viya vinassantaṃ akatvā suppaguṇasuppavattibhāvena hadaye ṭhapentīti dhammadharā.
Edisā ca attanā sutassa dhammassa ādhārabhūtā nāma hontīti āha “sutadhammānaṃ ādhārabhūtā”ti.
